# GVAI Safety Systems

GVAI Safety Systems is developing an advisory-first product for AI operations.

## Public pages
- https://gvaisafety.com/
- https://gvaisafety.com/features.html
- https://gvaisafety.com/pricing.html
- https://gvaisafety.com/developers.html

## Current product boundary
- The advisory API is priced at $99 USD per month.
- Public account registration, authentication, Stripe checkout, verified subscription entitlement, and API-key issuance are not connected.
- The backend source contains a private/loopback POST /v1/evaluations route, but no public customer API base URL is available.
- Live monitoring data and customer telemetry are not connected to this website.
- Ask GvAI chat is not connected; this website does not fabricate AI responses.
- ALLOW, QUALIFY, and BLOCK describe advisory outcomes only.
- GVAI does not provide automatic workload shutdown, policy enforcement, safety certification, or a guarantee of protection.
- Do not submit credentials, payment data, API keys, personal information, or sensitive system details to this site.

For current integration status, see https://gvaisafety.com/developers.html#status.
